description: This file defines the RequestFactory class within the Http\Factory\Guzzle namespace, implementing the RequestFactoryInterface to create HTTP request objects using GuzzleHttp's Request class.

classes.name: RequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Request objects conforming to PSR-7 RequestInterface.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new PSR-7 Request object with the specified HTTP method and URI.
